description: This PHP file defines a class Order within the Opencart administration module, specifically handling report tasks related to orders, such as sales, processing, completion, and other statuses. It includes methods for executing these reports and updating statistics accordingly.

classes.name: Order
classes.description: Controller class for managing order report tasks in OpenCart admin panel.

methods.name: index
methods.description: Initializes and adds order report tasks for sale, processing, complete, and other statuses, and returns a success message.

methods.name: sale
methods.description: Generates and records total sales statistics for completed orders.

methods.name: processing
methods.description: Generates and records total orders in processing status.

methods.name: complete
methods.description: Generates and records total completed orders.

methods.name: other
methods.description: Generates and records total orders with statuses other than processing or complete.
